prompts.name: hud_header_r3
prompts.prompt: Generate one original isolated game UI header panel for Legends of Rus, matching the antique-gold and nearly-black lacquer material of the Gameplay reference shown in the conversation. It is a blank asset, not a screenshot reproduction. Front view orthographic, no perspective. One very wide shallow rectangular opaque black-navy lacquer plaque, width about 4.4 times its height. Fine aged gold double rails along top and bottom, deep brown-gold recesses and restrained pale-gold bevel highlights. Dense but delicate curling carved gold acanthus/Slavic leaf scrolls localized to the four rounded corners, strongest at right end. Subtle worn charcoal surface with tiny old bronze scratches, mostly near edges. Small dark oxidized scrolls outside the extreme corners. NO central jewel at the top or bottom, NO objects in the center, NO internal dividers, NO icon circles, NO goals, NO gems, NO star, NO portrait, NO numbers or letters. All central space is dark and empty because real UI text and independent controls will cover it. The panel is intended as a top HUD extending behind a separate avatar at left and a separate moves circle near center. Shape must be wide and shallow with generous blank middle, not a tall ornamental picture frame. Keep ALL scrolls fully inside canvas, small transparent margin at sides. True transparent alpha outside the panel and in exterior filigree gaps, opaque lacquer inside. Do not paint a checkerboard, solid background, scene, drop shadow rectangle or placeholder transparency. Suggested image 1536 by 1024 with the complete wide shallow panel centered vertically and transparent unused space above/below. Artwork itself occupies roughly x40..1496, y340..682. Use finely painted dimensional metal, no neon or smooth generic vector style.
